question: What are the email addresses of all members in the 'YSWC 2015 Program Committee'?

query_1.description: Identify all person IDs who are members of the 'YSWC 2015 Program Committee'.
query_1.cypher_query:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(c:Committee)
WHERE c.name = 'YSWC 2015 Program Committee'
RETURN p.ID AS person_id
ORDER BY p.ID

query_2.description: Retrieve the email addresses for the committee members returned by query_1.
query_2.sql_query: SELECT Person AS person_id, VALUE AS email FROM has_an_email WHERE Person IN (48, 313, 403, 584, 585) ORDER BY Person
